title: From Local Mismatch to Global Impact: Optimizing Cache Reuse Policy for Efficient Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.13043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved dominant performance in visual generation but suffer from substantial inference overhead. While cache-based acceleration has emerged as a promising solution, existing policies rely on local similarity heuristics, which we identify as being significantly misaligned with final generation quality. This discrepancy stems from the non-uniform propagation and accumulation of errors along the denoising trajectory. To address this, we propose Global-Impact Cache (GCache). We first establish a rigorous theoretical characterization of the error propagation upper bound. Recognizing that this bound can be overly conservative for complex, highly non-convex diffusion models, we further reparameterize the propagation exponent with a Bernstein form and reformulate cache policy search as a bilevel optimization problem. translated_title: 从局部失配到全局影响：优化高效扩散的缓存重用策略
translated_abstract: 摘要：扩散模型在视觉生成中取得了主导性能，但面临显著的推理开销。虽然基于缓存的加速已成为一种有前景的解决方案，但现有策略依赖于局部相似性启发式方法，我们识别出这些方法与最终生成质量显著不匹配。这种差异源于去噪轨迹上误差的非均匀传播和累积。为解决此问题，我们提出了全局影响缓存（GCache）。我们首先建立了误差传播上界的严格理论表征。认识到该上界对于复杂、高度非凸的扩散模型可能过于保守，我们进一步用伯恩斯坦形式重新参数化传播指数，并将缓存策略搜索重新表述为双层优化问题。具体而言，GCache在内部目标中识别最优重用策略，同时使误差权重与全局影响对齐。
tldr: 提出GCache方法，通过理论误差传播分析和双层优化，设计全局影响感知的缓存重用策略，以提升扩散模型加速的生成质量。
en_tdlr: Propose GCache, a global-impact-aware cache reuse policy via theoretical error propagation analysis and bilevel optimization, improving generation quality for efficient diffusion models.
